title: Build wire transcript and enforce two-transcript isolation
author: dev-blueprint

create.reason: Append this turn's wire message to redacted history
Hard invariant: no original in any wire message (NG-1)

protected.reason: Rehydration is US-012; the wire must never contain rehydrated content
WireMessage type is fixed by the E1 contract; do not change it here

chain_order.reason: assert isolation invariant over the whole transcript

agent_prompt:
CONTEXT:
- Project: NorthGuard. Tech: TypeScript strict + Vitest.
- Current state: placeholders (US-009) and pseudonyms (US-010) done; verdict assembly (US-008) produces redactedPrompt. This story builds the wire transcript that the adapter transmits — the highest-severity correctness surface in the product.

TASK:
Implement US-011 (AF-306). The wire transcript is the ONLY content ever transmitted upstream, including as history on later turns (NG-1). Provide assertWireIsolation as a hard invariant.

CREATE FILES: per manifest.create. Signatures exactly per specs/EP-03-inspection-redaction/APP-FUNCTIONS.md (AF-306).

RULES:
1. TDD. The centrepiece test builds a 10-turn conversation containing redactions and asserts NO original value appears in ANY outbound wire message (the §8 acceptance test). Write this test first and make it fail meaningfully.
2. NG-14: this module is PURE and STATELESS — no fs, no db, no network imports. history is passed in; return a fresh array (never mutate history).
3. NG-1: prior turns in history are already redacted; never re-hydrate them into the wire. composeWireMessage appends only the redacted wireText.
4. assertWireIsolation(wire, originals) throws WireLeakError if any original substring appears; returns void otherwise. It must be cheap enough to call at runtime, not only in tests.
5. Do NOT import from rehydrate/** (protected) — rehydrated content must never reach the wire.
6. Report the 10-turn isolation test result explicitly in the summary.
